The prose gives an attempted 80–200 K range, but PL overlap limits useful data above 190 K; Figure
S2 displays 80–190 K. The misplaced Figure S1 callout is preserved as a source conflict. Cited PbO2
or other phase-mode explanations do not establish current contaminants.
